what_this_is: An example price test with one price in it. The surface is the plan card; each candidate is one offer the person sells; the decider splits visitors by weight and keeps each visitor on the same offer every time (the split is keyed by the visitor: an observer id fact when one is given, otherwise the visitor key the caller passes). One price is one candidate with all the weight. To test a second price, add its candidate and give it a weight in the split; nothing else changes. The offer names are made up.

decider.label: Split visitors across the offered prices by weight, the same visitor always on the same price
